scope: Read-only metadata listing of the approved encrypted production backup Drive folder and metadata read of its existing dump; no file contents, database rows, or recovery-key bytes were read
interpretation: The 60-day backup retention target is confirmed policy, but the approved folder contains one visible dump whose Drive metadata is 62.6 hours old, exceeding the 24-hour RPO by 38.6 hours. Modification time does not establish the dump's internal snapshot time. Drive lifecycle/expiry and recurring upload remain unverified. Only metadata was read; no backup contents, recovery key, database records, or Drive settings were accessed or changed.
